reason: Provides shared per-workspace project progress storage and session context through a PROGRESS.md file with read, update, and project-facts tools.

summaries.zh: 在工作区维护共享的 PROGRESS.md 项目进展文档，并在会话间提供项目状态上下文。
summaries.en: Maintains a shared workspace PROGRESS.md file and provides project status context across sessions.

capabilities: Creates or updates the workspace PROGRESS.md file
Injects project progress into new-session context
Appends session progress automatically at top-level session end
Provides tools for reading, updating, and replacing project progress sections
